channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Euro: Rebound tests key resistance band against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight a strong EUR/USD rebound to around 1.1200 after recent oversold weakness.

item.title: BoE’s Pill says a bit more sceptical about market pricing of four rate hikes over the next year
item.description: Bank of England (BoE) Chief Economist Huw Pill said on Wednesday that he is a bit more sceptical about market pricing of four rate hikes over the next year. Pill added that UK output and labor market have proven more resilient.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Hovers around 1.4200 after breaking below nine-day EMA
item.description: USD/CAD loses ground for the second successive day, trading around 1.4200 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates that the price is remaining within the ascending channel pattern, suggesting an ongoing bullish bias.

item.title: British Pound gains as UK assures fiscal discipline
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades higher against its major currency peers, except antipodeans, on Wednesday. In the early European trade, the British currency is up 0.2% at around 210.12 against the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: New Zealand Dollar drifts higher above 0.5600, all eyes on US CPI inflation data
item.description: The NZD/USD pair rebounds from a 17-month low to near 0.5625 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The US dollar (USD) weakens against the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) amid easing US bond yields and dovish signals from New York Federal Reserve (Fed) President John Williams.

item.title: Indian Rupee extends winning streak for third trading day on Wednesday
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends the rally against the US Dollar (USD) for the third trading day on Wednesday, driven by fresh Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) measures to curb the US Dollar’s (USD) demand.

item.title: Gold consolidates above $4,150 as softer USD lends support ahead of US CPI report
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) steadies above $4,150 during the Asian session on Wednesday, awaiting the release of the latest US inflation figures before the next leg of a directional move. The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) is due for release later today, followed by the Producer Price Index (PPI) on Thursday.

item.title: Swiss Franc strengthens as US Dollar slips on dovish Fed signals
item.description: USD/CHF extends its losses for the second consecutive day, trading around 0.8320 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair depreciated as the US Dollar (USD) lost ground following dovish remarks from New York Federal Reserve President John Williams.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Eases from two-week high; trades below $94.00 amid bullish setup
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – retreats from the vicinity of mid-$94.00s, or an over two-week high set during the Asian session on this Wednesday, snapping a four-day winning streak.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Gains ground below 177.50, but stays bearish below 100-day SMA
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 177.30 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) edges lower against the Euro (EUR) on a cautious Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate outlook.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold steadies, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices remained broadly unchanged in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: UK Finance Minister Healey to fund budget giveaways without extra borrowing — FT
item.description: UK Finance Minister John Healey is set to finance all new measures announced in the October 28 budget, including a cost-of-living support package, through higher taxes or reductions in public spending rather than additional borrowing, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Hits one-week top as bulls eye range breakout above 1.3300
item.description: The GBP/USD pair attracts some follow-through buying for the second straight day, advancing to a one-week high during the Asian session on Wednesday amid the ongoing US Dollar (USD) corrective slide.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Gains ground near 1.1150, US CPI awaited
item.description: The Euro (EUR) extends its Tuesday’s strong recovery move to near 1.1210 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trade on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD remains above $59.00 amid dovish Fed remarks
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground after two days of losses, trading around $59.20 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Wednesday. Non-yielding Silver gains following dovish remarks from New York Federal Reserve President John Williams.

item.title: Canadian Dollar edges up against US Dollar ahead of US CPI data
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) trades slightly higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday ahead of the United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data at 12:30 GMT. In the Asian trade, the USD/CAD pair is marginally down to near 1.4200, as the US Dollar extends its decline.

item.title: United States Dollar Index weakens to near 102.00 ahead of US CPI release
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 102.15 in the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The DXY declines following remarks from New York Federal Reserve (Fed) President John Williams.

item.title: Lagarde speech: We're not seeing any second round effects yet
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde said on Wednesday that inflation has been rising predominantly but not exclusively as a result of energy prices. Lagarde added that she’s not seeing any second round effects yet.

item.title: China’s Trade Balance: Surplus unexpectedly expands in September
item.description: China's Trade Balance for September, in Chinese Yuan (CNY) terms, arrived at CNY905.97 billion, widening from the previous figure of CNY809.3 billion. The market forecast was for CNY805 billion.

item.title: Australian Dollar gains against Japanese Yen as China CPI inflation rises in September
item.description: AUD/JPY extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around 110.70 during Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar clings to gains near 0.5620 vs USD after China's inflation data
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gains some positive traction for the second day on Wednesday, building on the overnight bounce from the 0.5580 support zone, or the lowest level since April 2025.

item.title: Australian Dollar holds gains following Chinese inflation data
item.description: AUD/USD gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 0.6990 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair remains stronger as the Australian Dollar (AUD) holds its gains following the release of Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation data from China, Australia’s major trading partner.

item.title: British Pound strengthens above 1.3250, traders await US CPI inflation data
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gathers strength to around 1.3260 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. Dovish signals from New York Federal Reserve (Fed) President John Williams weigh on the US Dollar (USD) against the British Pound (GBP).

item.title: Breaking: China’s CPI inflation rises to 0.9% YoY in September, vs. 1.0% expected
item.description: China’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed 0.9% in September from a year ago after arriving at a rise of 0.8% in August, the National Bureau of Statistics of China reported on Wednesday. The market consensus was for 1.0% in the reported period.

item.title: Japanese Yen softens as October BoJ hike bets fade; stuck in a range vs USD ahead of US CPI
item.description: The USD/JPY pair edges higher on Wednesday, trading near mid-158.00s during the Asian session and within striking distance of the monthly high, touched last week. Spot prices, however, remain confined in a familiar range as traders now look forward to the US inflation figures for a fresh impetus.

item.title: US President Donald Trump says Taiwan agrees to buy 30% of gas from Alaska pipeline
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that Taiwan agreed to purchase 30% of the gas from a proposed pipeline project in Alaska, according to Reuters. However, details of the agreement have not yet been disclosed.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7249 vs. 6.7298 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7249 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7298 and 6.6922 Reuters estimate.

item.title: WTI rises above $94.00 amid escalating Middle East hostilities, supply risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends its gains for the fifth consecutive day, trading around $94.30 per barrel during Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Euro edges higher above 1.1200 despite France fiscal risks, US CPI in focus
item.description: The EUR/USD pair holds positive ground near 1.1205 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the Euro (EUR) following remarks from New York Federal Reserve (Fed) President John Williams.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis fire missiles at Saudi Arabia; Aramco facility catches fire
item.description: Yemen’s Houthi rebels launched a series of missile attacks targeting cities across Saudi Arabia as the military said projectiles are being intercepted. Falling shrapnel in Dhahran and Riyadh injured at least four people in the Saudi capital.
